address: 16, Alley 4, Lane 217, Section 3, Zhongxiao East Road, Da’an District, Taipei, 106080, Taiwan
bio: Aleisha serves pan-Mediterranean fare with a Middle Eastern twist in wittily named dishes that add to the fun. A sea urchin shooter (dubbed "See Your Chin") captures the essence of the sea in one bite thanks to accompaniments such as toasted nori, pickled seaweed and crabmeat. "Pigaboo" is another standout: juicy slow-cooked pork dusted with the spice sumac for citrus tartness. Oenophiles can pick out their own wine in the cellar.
